For parents and carers

A small routine.
A stronger foundation.

Give primary maths practice a clear place in the day, with a football player your child can customise and a next question chosen from their learning record.

Create a player

A useful first session

01

Find a starting point

A short warm-up samples the year’s skills. Earlier gaps can lead to supporting questions.

02

Train what matters

Practise a focus table, written methods, weaker skills and a wider curriculum mix.

03

Remember it later

Mistakes get a replay. Earlier facts return on later days, as recall evidence develops.

  • Choose a nickname and a suitable starting practice year.
  • Try one short warm-up or match. Keep an example available when an idea is new.
  • Ask your child to explain one answer or demonstrate it with objects.
  • Use the grown-up report for practical checks and a next exercise when a learner repeatedly needs help.
  • Return on another day. There is no loss of earned kit or credits for taking a break.

Rewards with a clear purpose

Complete a Coach match to bank experience for new and due facts answered independently in the player’s year. Every 10 XP earns one credit for shirts, boots, balls and other cosmetic items. Free practice still saves learning and goals. Levels rise quickly at the beginning, then require more experience. Club offers are fictional game rewards, with no affiliation to the professional teams named.

A short round has a full-time result and a clear stopping point. The daily goals are optional milestones. There are no payments, random prizes or paid learning advantages.

Can several children use one computer?

Yes. Each chosen player has separate saved learning evidence, scores, kit and progress. Switch player before the next child begins. The squad league compares profiles in this browser. The hosted academy also offers a separate, optional World League using generated aliases.

Can we move progress to another device?

Use Backup in the grown-up area, then restore the JSON backup on the other browser. Keep a backup before clearing browser data. There is no automatic cross-device sync.

Will a higher XP level promote a school year?

No. XP levels and club rewards are separate from academy-year completion. Promotion uses practice evidence, practical checks and a mixed promotion match.

What if reading is difficult?

Use the dyslexia-friendly layout, quieter motion or read-aloud. These are reading preferences, not treatment or diagnosis. Available voices depend on the device.
